Only repos matching all of the criteria below are changed; non-matching repos are left as-is (this differs from GitHub's org-level "Matching a filter" policy, which also governs future repos — ours is a one-time bulk apply).

Enter an enterprise slug above and click Load organizations to get started.

Code Quality has no org-level API yet, so toggling an org here applies the repo-level code-quality/setup API across every repo in that org, in the background. Orgs can hold 10k+ repos, so per-repo detail is intentionally not shown in this table.
